chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Mizham, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a Muslim slave who has a Christian mother, and for the slave is a free son. It was said, 'Do you see if the mother of the slave dies and leaves wealth?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is inherited by her son, the free (grandson).'

key_terms.ابْنُ ابْنِهَا: Her son (maternal grandson of the slave)

ai.seo_question: Who inherits the wealth of a Christian mother when her son is a Muslim slave and her grandson is free?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the inheritance dynamics between a Muslim slave and his free brother, specifically addressing the exclusion of the slave by the free heir when inheriting from their mother. It highlights the Shia juristic principle that 'al-ḥurr yuḥīḍ al-ʿabd' (the free heir excludes the slave) in cases of mixed status, ensuring the free son receives the entirety of the mother's estate. This ruling underscores the significance of freedom (ḥuriyyah) as a primary determinant of inheritance rights in classical fiqh.
